roles.drugs: Superficial BCC in low-risk sites: topical imiquimod 5% or 5-fluorouracil 5% (both FDA-approved for superficial BCC; recurrence generally higher than with surgery, but cosmesis may be superior); also cryotherapy, photodynamic therapy
